subject: Request: assign procurement reference and redistribute SKU lines for onboarding
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: procurement@orionanalytics.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: assign procurement reference and redistribute SKU lines for onboarding

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the kickoff call last week. We need a formal procurement reference (PO number) to complete onboarding in our billing system and to honor the spend cap splits the customer requested. Attached are: our completed onboarding form and a CSV with the SKU/line items we plan to ship across the first quarter.

What we need from Orion to move forward:
- A provisional procurement reference (PO) we can use for initial provisioning and internal ledgering.
- Confirmation of spend cap allocation per line (monthly caps, and an annual ceiling). Our proposed split is below. If Orion cannot accept the split, please indicate the closest mapping you can support.
- Any vendor-side onboarding form or W-9 you need back from us.

Proposed allocation (example):
- Line 1001 (Base inference units): $30,000 / month, annual cap $120,000
- Line 1002 (Burst GPU credits): $20,000 / month, annual cap $80,000

Notes: the customer (Orion) asked for a hard monthly spend cap on Line 1002 during peak runs. We will need the PO to explicitly reference these caps so our finance system can enforce the spend controls.

Attached: redwood_onboarding_form_laura_20250512.pdf; proposed_line_mapping_20250512.csv

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday (48 hours) so we can request PO issuance from finance? If you prefer, we can accept a provisional PO and an official PO number once your internal approvals finish.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Partnerships Manager — Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0129

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@orionanalytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: assign procurement reference and redistribute SKU lines for onboarding

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the PDF and the mapping CSV. We can assign a provisional PO while our procurement team completes the standard review, but I need a bit more detail on how Redwood wants the monthly hard cap enforced on our side. Our system supports budget tags per line, but not a per-line hard stop that prevents ordering; typically we put soft alerts and a notification to the requester.

Questions: 
1) Do you need a hard stop (reject orders when the monthly cap is reached) or formal alerts with override by the finance approver?
2) For the Burst GPU credits (Line 1002) — do you want those to draw from a separate ledger or from the same account but flagged with a special budget tag?

I've attached our vendor_setup_form_20250512.pdf for your legal/operations team to complete and return. If you can confirm the enforcement behavior (hard stop vs alert) we can draft a provisional PO in the format your finance team needs.

Best,
Maya Singh
Procurement Manager
Orion Analytics
maya.singh@orionanalytics.com
External Attachment: vendor_setup_form_20250512.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@orionanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: assign procurement reference and redistribute SKU lines for onboarding

FYI — forwarding Maya's note. Maya asked whether Orion can enforce a hard stop per-line. Their default is alerts.

Ben / Priyom: finance needs to issue the procurement reference. Proposed path: finance issues a provisional PO with line splits and the following coding so we can auto-enforce spend caps on our side: 

Proposed PO structure for Finance to issue (for internal use):
- PO holder: Orion Analytics
- PO reference (provisional): please create a PO with prefix PO-RED- and a sequential ID; we'll swap to their official number if they provide one.
- Lines:
  * PO Line A (code 1001): Description: Base inference units — monthly cap $30,000 — GL code: INF-BSE-1001
  * PO Line B (code 1002): Description: Burst GPU credits — monthly cap $20,000 — GL code: INF-BURST-1002
- Billing terms: monthly invoice reporting with line-item consumption detail; finance should set two budget tags to allow us to surface alerts when consumption reaches 90% and 100%.

Maya, is Orion ok with us creating a provisional PO with PO-RED-87421 while you run your internal approval? If so I'll request the provisional PO today and share the PDF with you and Orion's AP to keep everything in sync.

Short ask: Ben — can you raise the provisional PO (PO-RED-xxxx) and attach to this thread? If you can't today, flag the blocker (finance queue / signer) so I can loop in Ops.

Thanks,
Laura

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: assign procurement reference and redistribute SKU lines for onboarding

Laura / Priyom —

I've routed the request through finance and requested a provisional procurement reference: PO-RED-87421. Finance generated the provisional PDF (attached) and set budget tags per line so our billing system can surface 90%/100% alerts. They do not block at line 100% — our practice is to surface an alert and route approvals to the AP team. If Orion requires a hard stop we can discuss implementing an override flow, but that will require a longer change window.

Attached: PO-RED-87421.pdf (application/pdf)

Action items: 
- Maya: please confirm Orion will accept a provisional PO with our PO-RED-87421 reference while you finish internal approvals. If Orion needs a hard stop, let us know the exact behavior so we can route an engineering change request.
- Maya/Orion AP: can you confirm the billing contact we should send the monthly line-item usage reports to?

I'll update the ledger and tag the two lines as INF-BSE-1001 and INF-BURST-1002.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0187
